rows.meaning: sport set of top and trousers
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a tracksuit or sports outfit.

example.english: I usually wear a tracksuit to go running; it makes warming up convenient.
example.traditional: 我通常着運動服去跑步，方便熱身。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 zoek3 wan6 dung6 fuk6 heoi3 paau2 bou6 fong1 bin6 jit6 san1

rows.meaning: sport set of top and trousers
rows.note: Use this when you want to make the matching top-and-trousers set explicit.

example.english: This tracksuit is what I wear before playing ball.
example.traditional: 呢套運動衫褲係我打波之前着嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 wan6 dung6 saam1 fu3 hai6 ngo5 daa2 bo1 zi1 cin4 zoek3 ge3
